description: Search emails by keyword on this machine. Reads the newest messages (default 200), decrypts encrypted ones locally and matches subject, sender, recipients and text (for encrypted messages, the first 280 characters unless full_text is set). The Voidly server is never asked to search. Does not mark messages as read.

full_text.description: Also download and search whole encrypted bodies (slower; downloads stop after about 64 MiB per search)

query.description: Nonempty search query (case-insensitive substring; surrounding spaces are ignored)

scan.description: How many of the newest messages to search (default 200, max 1000)

name: voidmail_search_inbox
